shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼拿下点击，用冷白底交代短款衣长与开襟结构。
一秒给出核心利益：衣长齐腰、双手可插袋，主图一秒法则。
用买家自拍视角完成上身代入，证明短款配高腰下装的日常比例。
微距特写做工，证明门襟闭合与罗纹收边的织造品质。
用同框侧身与背侧双面板回答袖长、帽型与后背长度疑虑。
让买家一次比较色路，降低选款犹豫并提升加购件数。
以成套搭配与留空行动按钮收口，把单品浏览转成整套下单。

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cool-grey women's active-casual apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool studio white #FFFFFF, fog blue-grey seamless #E7EAEE, graphite #22252A and one chrome silver accent #9EAAB6; bright cool high-key studio lighting from a large frontal softbox with a right fill card, low skimming side light only where the closure line, rib band and hood relief must read, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern grotesque sans-serif with tight tracking; single-weight thin-line icon style in chrome silver with dotted leader lines, unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames; matte seamless paper cyclorama and graphite matte board surfaces, no gradient and no warm surfaces; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 on-body garment angle with identical crop line, drape and scale, model always generic with the face cropped or turned away; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
